newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul won ends at July low despite intervention.
newsitem.headline: Seoul won ends at July low despite intervention.

text.p: The South Korean won closed at a July low of 894.90 against the dollar on Friday despite the central bank's repeated intervention, dealers said.
It compared with the pervious close of 893.50 on Wednesday. Thursday was a market holiday.
Dealers said dollar buying was strong amid jitters over the Kia Group's financial troubles and over the plunges of Thai and Philippine currencies.
The Bank of Korea sold dollars at 916.00 won in six-month forward trading in early afternoon and again at 905.50 won in three-month forward trading, they said.
